Class Player

java.lang.Object
model.common.Entity
model.player.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Collidable, Damageable, Renderable, Updatable
public class Player extends Entity
The player character controlled by user input. Moves via WASD/arrow keys and automatically attacks the nearest enemy with all equipped weapons. Can equip up to 4 weapons simultaneously.
